summary: M5.1 payments foundation + UZS regression fully verified. All 69 pytest tests pass (20 catalog + 12 auth + 14 filters + 23 payments). Added 14 additional E2E API tests hitting the public URL against the CLICK mock simulator and raw HTTP protocol — all 14 pass. Verified UZS currency in catalog API and across homepage/PLP/PDP/search. Login as customer works and /account loads correctly with ID-locale so'm announcement string. No MongoDB refs in backend. No CLICK_MOCK_SECRET_KEY in frontend source or bundle. payment_events meta is empty (no secrets logged). Fail-closed mode gates verified in code (factory.py raises on missing creds; unknown mode raises). Mock simulator hard-gated by CLICK_MODE=mock in routes.py.
critical_code_review_comments: signature.py cleanly uses hmac.compare_digest and MD5 over raw ordered fields — good.
factory.py fails closed on unknown mode and missing credentials — good.
routes.py mock endpoints are guarded by _require_mock_mode() and 404 when CLICK_MODE != 'mock' — good.
payment_events meta is empty {} for CREATE/PREPARE/COMPLETE — no secret material leaked.
Amount comparison enforces string fidelity: signing '350000.00' but sending '350000' yields -1 (verified via raw HTTP test).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed. Test data was mock payment orders (safe: mock-only, no financial effect).
